About Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serves New York-style sourdough pizza by the slice in Copenhagen from our locations at Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej. We combine traditional American slice shop recipes with quality ingredients, cold-fermented dough, and high-heat deck ovens. We run busy counter, dine-in, and delivery services, and we are actively building for future growth.

The Role

As Kitchen Manager, you are responsible for the day-to-day operations of the kitchen. You make sure food quality is consistent across all orders, keep kitchen systems clean and compliant, and guide the kitchen team in close coordination with our front of house (FOH) staff.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Daily kitchen operations, including prep, baking, and ongoing quality control

• 
Ordering goods, receiving deliveries, and inventory management

• 
Directing, training, and supervising kitchen staff on shift

• 
Maintaining strict kitchen cleanliness, hygiene routines, and Danish food safety standards

• 
Serving as the main kitchen contact point for FOH during service

• 
Managing rush periods and high-volume delivery tickets calmly and efficiently

Requirements

• 
Minimum 3 years of experience in the hospitality industry

• 
Experience with pizza OR experience with management is required (experience managing a pizza kitchen is a strong advantage)

• 
Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills

• 
Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours

• 
Comfortable working full shifts on your feet

• 
Ready and available to work evening and weekend shifts

• 
Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus)

What We Offer

• 
Hourly wage of 175 – 185 DKK/hour based on experience

• 
Training and technical skills in producing world-class New York-style pizza

• 
A hardworking but friendly and supportive atmosphere

• 
A growing company with opportunities to take on more responsibility and higher pay over time

• 
A flexible schedule

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to:Email: work@diamondslice.dkSubject line: Kitchen ManagerApplications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Erfaren Kok / Kitchen Lead – Rays Chicken på Gamma Bar (Nordvest)
jobs.description:
Dansk Version - English version below

Erfaren Kok / Kitchen Lead – Rays Chicken på Gamma Bar (Nordvest)

Lokation: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, København

Ansættelsesform: Deltid / Fuldtid (Aftener og weekender)

Løn: 165 – 185 kr./time (baseret på erfaring)

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

Om Rays Chicken

Hos Rays Chicken tager vi fried chicken seriøst. Vi laver ekstra sprød, kærnemælksmarineret fried chicken krydret med vores egen hemmelige krydderiblanding, som vi serverer for et livligt og fyldt Gamma Bar i København Nordvest.

Vi lægger i øjeblikket fundamentet for spændende fremtidig vækst og søger en dedikeret kok, der har lyst til at være en central del af den rejse.

Rollen

Vi søger en erfaren og pålidelig køkkenprofil, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift, opretholde en høj madkvalitet og bevare overblikket under travle perioder.

På de mere rolige vagter i starten af ugen har du fuld frihed og selvstændighed til at preppe og køre køkkenet alene. På de travle aftener styrer du servicen og leder køkkenets medhjælpere og opvaskere.

Vigtigste ansvarsområder:

• 
Mise en place og service: Daglig klargøring, madlavning, fritering, anretning og sikring af en høj standard.

• 
Selvstændige vagter: Ansvar for at drive køkkendriften solo på ugens tidlige vagter.

• 
Teamledelse: Vagtplanlægning, instruktion og supervision af køkkenmedhjælpere og opvaskere.

• 
Lager og indkøb: Styring af varebeholdning, varebestillinger, varemodtagelse samt daglig kontakt med leverandører.

• 
Hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed: Holde orden i køkkenets systemer og strengt overholde danske standarder for fødevarehygiejne og egenkontrol.

• 
Digitale bestillinger: Effektiv betjening af takeaway- og online bestillingsplatforme.

• 
Menuudvikling (Bonus): Vi ønsker aktivt at videreudvikle vores menu. Selvom det ikke er et krav, er interesse for opskriftsudvikling og kreative input et stort plus!

Hvem er du?

• 
Erfaring: Minimum 3 års professionel køkkenerfaring.

• 
Selvstændighed: Tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt uden direkte supervision og med stærke beslutningsevner.

• 
Tempo og overblik: Meget velstruktureret og organiseret, og motiveres af at arbejde hurtigt og slå uret under travle perioder.

• 
Fysisk form: Kan trives med at arbejde fulde vagter på benene.

• 
Tilgængelighed: Klar og parat til at arbejde aften- og weekendvagter.

• 
Kommunikation: Gode engelskkundskaber (dansk er en kærkommen bonus).

• 
Passion: En ægte kærlighed til fried chicken og comfort food i høj kvalitet.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
Timeløn mellem 165 og 185 kr./time baseret på erfaring.

• 
En afslappet, lokalt forankret stemning på Gamma Bar i det kreative Nordvest.

• 
Mulighed for at præge de daglige arbejdsgange og få indflydelse på fremtidige menu-tiltag i takt med, at konceptet udvider sig.

Sådan ansøger du

Send dit CV samt en kort motiveret ansøgning om, hvorfor du er det rette match for Rays Chicken til:

• 
E-mail: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Emnefelt: Rays Chefs

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!------------------

English Version

Location: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, Copenhagen

Employment Type: Part-time / Full-time (Evenings & Weekends)

Pay: 165 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as possible

About Rays Chicken

At Rays Chicken, we take fried chicken seriously. We make extra-crispy, buttermilk-brined fried chicken seasoned with our proprietary secret spice mix, serving the vibrant, packed crowd at the popular neighborhood spot Gamma Bar in Copenhagen Nordvest.

We are currently laying the groundwork for exciting future growth, and we are looking for a dedicated chef who wants to be an integral part of that journey.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dependable kitchen professional who can take charge of daily kitchen operations, maintain high standards of quality, and keep a cool head during busy periods.

On slower early-week shifts, you will have full autonomy to prep and run the kitchen independently. On busier nights, you will lead the service and direct kitchen support staff.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Food Prep & Service: Daily mise en place, cooking, frying, plating, and ensuring high food quality.

• 
Independent Shifts: Running kitchen operations solo during early-week shifts.

• 
Team Leadership: Scheduling, guiding, and overseeing kitchen helpers and dishwashers.

• 
Stock & Orders: Managing inventory, placing orders, receiving deliveries, and liaising with daily suppliers.

• 
Hygiene & Safety: Keeping kitchen systems organized and strictly upholding Danish food safety and sanitation standards.

• 
Digital Orders: Operating takeaway and online delivery platforms efficiently.

• 
Menu Input (Bonus): We are actively looking to develop our menu. While not a strict requirement, an interest in recipe testing and creative input is a big plus!

What We Are Looking For:

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional kitchen experience.

• 
Independence: Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills.

• 
Pace & Mindset: Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours.

• 
Stamina: Comfortable working full shifts on your feet.

• 
Availability: Ready and available to work evenings and weekends.

• 
Communication: Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus).

• 
Passion: A true love for fried chicken and high-quality comfort food.

What We Offer:

• 
Hourly wage between 165 and 185 DKK/hour, commensurate with experience.

• 
A relaxed, community-driven atmosphere at Gamma Bar in creative Nordvest.

• 
Opportunity to shape operational routines and influence future menu offerings as the concept expands.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit for Rays Chicken to:

• 
Email: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Subject line: Rays Chefs

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

• 
Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

• 
Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

• 
Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

• 
Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

• 
Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

• 
Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

• 
Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

• 
Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

• 
Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

• 
Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

• 
Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

• 
Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

• 
Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

• 
Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

• 
Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

• 
Demonstrated passion for driving positive change for customers and their businesses, coupled with a willingness to travel both professionally and personally.

Why Join Us?

• 
Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.

• 
Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.

• 
Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere

• 
Work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

• 
Experience a dynamic workplace where team spirit, joy, and productivity go hand in hand.

• 
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Career growth and professional development opportunities.

• 
A collaborative and inclusive work culture.

Workplace

Work from either our Copenhagen or Aalborg offices and have the chance to visit our Brisbane location. Join our global team spanning Denmark, Sweden, India, the US, and Australia.

How to Apply

For more details, please contact our People and Culture Team at hr@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

At TravelOperations, we're not just about professionalism and ambition; we're about building an environment where every employee shines. Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions.
